aircraft_registration: Dutch aircraft registration: PH- and three letters, like `PH-XYZ`, or the forms for drones (`PH-1AB`), microlights (`PH-1A1`) and gliders (`PH-1234`).
bic: BIC (SWIFT code) of a Dutch bank: four letters, NL and two letters or digits, with an optional three-character branch code, like `ABNANL2A` or `RABONL2UXXX`.
bsn: Dutch citizen service number (BSN, burgerservicenummer, sofinummer): nine digits after BSN, burgerservicenummer, sofinummer or persoonsnummer, keyword included, or on its own when written `1234.56.789`.
company_name: Dutch company name (handelsnaam): capitalized words, initials or van/de/der, followed by B.V., BV, N.V., NV, V.O.F., VOF, C.V. or U.A., like `Bakkerij van Dam B.V.`, or a Stichting and its name.
document_number: Dutch passport or identity card number (documentnummer): two letters, six letters or digits and a final digit, never the letter O, like `SPECI2014`.
ecli: European Case Law Identifier (ECLI) of a Dutch court ruling (uitspraak): ECLI:NL:, the court, the year and the number, like `ECLI:NL:HR:2020:1234`.
iban: Dutch IBAN: NL, two check digits, a four-letter bank code and ten digits, with or without spaces, like `NL91 ABNA 0417 1643 00`.
iccid: SIM card number (ICCID) of a Dutch SIM: 8931 followed by 14 to 16 digits, without spaces, like `89310412345678901230`.
imsi: IMSI (subscriber identity on a SIM) of a Dutch network: mobile country code 204 and 12 more digits, 15 in all, like `204041234567890`.
kvk_number: Dutch Chamber of Commerce number (KvK-nummer): eight digits after KvK, Kamer van Koophandel, handelsregister or CoC, keyword included, like `KvK-nummer: 68750110`.
license_plate: Dutch license plate (kenteken) in all sidecodes, with dashes like `AB-12-34`, `12-GBB-3` or `G-123-BB`, or without dashes like `GBB12B`.
mobile_number: Dutch mobile number (06-nummer): 06, +31 6, 0031 6 or +31 (0)6 and eight digits, with spaces or dashes, like `06-12345678`; only valid Dutch mobile numbers.
mrz_id_card: Machine-readable zone (MRZ) of a Dutch identity card, first line (ICAO TD1): 30 characters with NLD as issuing country, like `I<NLDSPECI20142999999990<<<<<<`.
mrz_passport: Machine-readable zone (MRZ) of a Dutch passport, second line (ICAO TD3): 44 characters with the document number, NLD as nationality, date of birth, sex and expiry date.
msisdn: Dutch mobile number in MSISDN form, as in telecom records: 31 and the number without its 0, 11 digits like `31612345678`; only valid Dutch mobile numbers.
phone_number: Dutch phone number (telefoonnummer): ten digits, landline or 06 mobile, national or with +31, 0031 or +31 (0), with spaces or dashes, like `010 123 4567`; only real Dutch area codes.
postal_code: Dutch postal code (postcode): four digits and two letters, with or without a space, like `1234 AB` or `9999ZZ`; SA, SD and SS are never used, and KB, MB, GB and TB are left out.
premium_number: Dutch premium-rate number (0900-nummer): 0900, 0906 or 0909 and four or seven digits, with spaces or dashes, like `0906 1234` or `0900-123 4567`; only valid Dutch numbers.
rsin: Dutch legal entity number (RSIN, Rechtspersonen en Samenwerkingsverbanden Informatienummer) after the keyword RSIN, keyword included: nine digits, like `RSIN: 9999.00.006`.
street_address: Dutch street address (adres): a name ending in straat, laan, weg, gracht, kade, plein, singel, dijk or the like, and the house number with addition, like `Dorpsstraat 12A` or `Molenkade 3-II`.
tikkie_link: Tikkie payment request link (betaalverzoek): tikkie.me/pay/ and the request code, with or without https:// or www., like `https://tikkie.me/pay/AbCd1234EfGh5678`.
vat_number: Dutch VAT number (btw-nummer, btw-id): NL, nine digits, B and two digits, also with spaces or dots, like `NL999999990B01` or `NL 9999.99.999.B.67`.
